description: This file contains a series of unit tests for the BufferList class's indexOf method, verifying its behavior with various inputs, encodings, boundary cases, and internal algorithms. It uses the 'tape' testing framework and references the 'Buffer' class from Node.js buffer module.

classes.name: BufferList
classes.description: A class that manages a list of Buffer objects and provides methods to manipulate and search buffers, including the indexOf method.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Searches for a pattern (string, Buffer, Uint8Array, or BufferList) within the BufferList instance, supporting various encodings and offsets.
